_comment: Weights of the day's top matches (miniapp/sports/top.py). Popularity of a match from source facts only: competition, stage, table positions, status. Never the model's or Claude's confidence. A competition weighted at or below otherCompetition (lower tiers, women's leagues) gets stage/table bonuses capped at otherStageCap, like an unlisted one. National-team competitions are weighted so that an international break shows its matches, not lower-tier club games (14.11); up to 3 per competition (15.11: Spain - England was dropped behind two equal Nations League matches for a far weaker club game). featuredTeams: provider team ids (resolved from the real calendars on 14.11, never names: Liverpool FC of Uruguay or a club's women's team share the name); a match with one of them gets featuredOne, with two featuredBoth, as part of the stage/table bonus (so capped for minor competitions). National teams have no table or league tier in the source: this list is the only signal that separates Portugal - Denmark from Faroe Islands - Moldova.
